captions.detailed: A compact home-video camcorder with a dark grey/black body, a flat side-mounted screen, a textured front zoom lens, and small control buttons on the top. The side screen is designed to swing outward on a vertical hinge, and the multi-ringed front lens can rotate continuously around its optical axis. Small rectangular push buttons on the top and side surfaces operate as independent prismatic controls.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a compact home-video camcorder with a dark grey main body, a front-facing zoom lens, a flat side screen, and top-mounted buttons. Incorporate a revolute joint for the side screen to swing outward, a continuous joint for the front lens ring to rotate, and prismatic joints for the buttons to depress.
captions.factory: The camcorder is constructed using an ArticulatedObject builder. The main body is formed from a rounded Box primitive. The lens assembly consists of multiple layered Cylinder primitives centered on the front face, with one cylinder designated as a rotating lens ring via a continuous joint. The side screen is modeled as a flat Box connected to the body via a revolute joint. Small rectangular Box primitives are positioned on the top and side surfaces, each configured with a prismatic joint to simulate push-button controls.
